parameter.label: P_CODPROD : multiList:Text
parameter.expression:
SELECT CODPROD AS VALUE, CODPROD||'- '||DESCRPROD AS LABEL FROM TGFPRO
ORDER BY DESCRPROD

parameter.label: P_CODVEND : multiList:Text
parameter.expression:
SELECT CODVEND AS VALUE, CODVEND||'- '||APELIDO AS LABEL FROM TGFVEN
WHERE ATIVO = 'S'
ORDER BY APELIDO

parameter.label: P_CODEMP : multiList:Text
parameter.expression:
SELECT CODEMP AS VALUE,
CODEMP||'- '||NOMEFANTASIA AS LABEL
FROM TSIEMP
ORDER BY NOMEFANTASIA

parameter.label: P_CODPARC : multiList:Text
parameter.expression: SELECT DISTINCT CAB.CODPARC AS VALUE, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL AS LABEL FROM TGFCAB CAB LEFT JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC WHERE CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND CAB.TIPMOV = 'P' ORDER BY PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL

parameter.label: P_TOP : multiList:Text
parameter.expression: SELECT DISTINCT CODTIPOPER AS VALUE, CODTIPOPER || '- ' || DESCROPER AS LABEL FROM TGFTOP ORDER BY LABEL
